passages.text: This is a prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth: O LORD, I have heard the report of You; I stand in awe, O LORD, of Your deeds. Revive them in these years; make them known in these years. In Your wrath, remember mercy!
passages.sermon:
Habakkuk was a prophet.
Habakkuk prayed this prayer.
Habakkuk prayed with strong emotion.
Habakkuk said, “LORD, I have heard about You.”
Habakkuk said, “I am in awe of Your deeds, LORD.”
Habakkuk asked God to revive His works in these years.
Habakkuk asked God to make His works known in these years.
Habakkuk asked God to remember mercy during His wrath.
passages.original: תְּפִלָּ֖ה לַחֲבַקּ֣וּק הַנָּבִ֑יא עַ֖ל שִׁגְיֹנֽוֹת׃ יְהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי שִׁמְעֲךָ֮ יָרֵאתִי֒ יְהוָ֗ה פָּֽעָלְךָ֙ בְּקֶ֤רֶב שָׁנִים֙ חַיֵּ֔יהוּ בְּקֶ֥רֶב שָׁנִ֖ים תּוֹדִ֑יעַ בְּרֹ֖גֶז רַחֵ֥ם תִּזְכּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God came from Teman.
The Holy One came from Mount Paran.
Selah.
God’s glory covered the heavens.
God’s praise filled the earth.
passages.original: אֱל֙וֹהַ֙ מִתֵּימָ֣ן יָב֔וֹא וְקָד֥וֹשׁ מֵֽהַר־ פָּארָ֖ן סֶ֑לָה כִּסָּ֤ה שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ הוֹד֔וֹ וּתְהִלָּת֖וֹ מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: His radiance was like the sunlight; rays flashed from His hand, where His power is hidden.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God is holy and powerful.
God’s radiance shone brightly.
His radiance was like sunlight.
Rays came from His hand.
His power was hidden there.
passages.original: וְנֹ֙גַהּ֙ כָּא֣וֹר תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה קַרְנַ֥יִם מִיָּד֖וֹ ל֑וֹ וְשָׁ֖ם חֶבְי֥וֹן עֻזֹּֽה׃

passages.text: Plague went before Him, and fever followed in His steps.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God moves with great power.
Plague goes before God.
Fever follows after God.
Plague and fever show God's might.
passages.original: לְפָנָ֖יו יֵ֣לֶךְ דָּ֑בֶר וְיֵצֵ֥א רֶ֖שֶׁף לְרַגְלָֽיו׃

passages.text: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.
passages.sermon:
God stood.
God measured the earth.
God looked at the nations.
The nations became afraid.
The ancient mountains broke apart.
The everlasting hills fell down.
God’s ways last forever.
passages.original: עָמַ֣ד׀ וַיְמֹ֣דֶד אֶ֗רֶץ רָאָה֙ וַיַּתֵּ֣ר גּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּתְפֹּֽצְצוּ֙ הַרְרֵי־ עַ֔ד שַׁח֖וּ גִּבְע֣וֹת עוֹלָ֑ם הֲלִיכ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress; the curtains of Midian were trembling.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Habakkuk saw something.
He saw the tents of Cushan.
The people in Cushan were in distress.
He also saw the land of Midian.
The curtains in Midian were trembling.
The people in Midian were afraid.
passages.original: תַּ֣חַת אָ֔וֶן רָאִ֖יתִי אָהֳלֵ֣י כוּשָׁ֑ן יִרְגְּז֕וּן יְרִיע֖וֹת אֶ֥רֶץ מִדְיָֽן׃ס

passages.text: Were You angry at the rivers, O LORD? Was Your wrath against the streams? Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses, on Your chariots of salvation?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
The LORD shows anger.
The LORD can show wrath against rivers.
The LORD can show wrath against streams.
The LORD can rage against the sea.
The LORD rides on horses.
The LORD rides on chariots of salvation.
passages.original: הֲבִנְהָרִים֙ חָרָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אִ֤ם בַּנְּהָרִים֙ אַפֶּ֔ךָ אִם־ בַּיָּ֖ם עֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י תִרְכַּב֙ עַל־ סוּסֶ֔יךָ מַרְכְּבֹתֶ֖יךָ יְשׁוּעָֽה׃

passages.text: You brandished Your bow; You called for many arrows. Selah You split the earth with rivers.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God brandished His bow.
God called for many arrows.
God split the earth with rivers.
passages.original: עֶרְיָ֤ה תֵעוֹר֙ קַשְׁתֶּ֔ךָ שְׁבֻע֥וֹת מַטּ֖וֹת אֹ֣מֶר סֶ֑לָה נְהָר֖וֹת תְּבַקַּע־ אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The mountains saw You and quaked; torrents of water swept by. The deep roared with its voice and lifted its hands on high.
passages.sermon:
God appeared in power.
The mountains saw God.
The mountains shook with fear.
Rushing water swept past.
The deep sea roared loudly.
The deep sea lifted its hands high.
passages.original: רָא֤וּךָ יָחִ֙ילוּ֙ הָרִ֔ים זֶ֥רֶם מַ֖יִם עָבָ֑ר נָתַ֤ן תְּהוֹם֙ קוֹל֔וֹ ר֖וֹם יָדֵ֥יהוּ נָשָֽׂא׃

passages.text: Sun and moon stood still in their places at the flash of Your flying arrows, at the brightness of Your shining spear.
passages.sermon:
God showed His great power.
The sun stopped moving.
The moon stopped moving.
They stood still in their places.
God sent out His arrows.
The arrows flashed with light.
God’s spear shone brightly.
The sun and moon stood still because of the light from God’s arrows and spear.
passages.original: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ יָרֵ֖חַ עָ֣מַד זְבֻ֑לָה לְא֤וֹר חִצֶּ֙יךָ֙ יְהַלֵּ֔כוּ לְנֹ֖גַהּ בְּרַ֥ק חֲנִיתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: You marched across the earth with fury; You threshed the nations in wrath.
passages.sermon:
God acted with great anger.
God marched across the earth.
God showed His fury.
God punished the nations.
God threshed the nations in His wrath.
passages.original: בְּזַ֖עַם תִּצְעַד־ אָ֑רֶץ בְּאַ֖ף תָּד֥וּשׁ גּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, to save Your anointed. You crushed the head of the house of the wicked and stripped him from head to toe. Selah With his own spear You pierced his head, when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though ready to secretly devour the weak.
passages.sermon:
God went out to save His people.
God went out to save His anointed one.
God crushed the head of the wicked house.
God stripped the wicked from head to toe.
Selah.
God pierced the leader of the wicked with his own spear.
The wicked leader’s warriors rushed out to scatter us.
They rejoiced as if they would secretly devour the weak.
passages.original: יָצָ֙אתָ֙ לְיֵ֣שַׁע עַמֶּ֔ךָ לְיֵ֖שַׁע אֶת־ מְשִׁיחֶ֑ךָ מָחַ֤צְתָּ רֹּאשׁ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע עָר֛וֹת יְס֥וֹד עַד־ צַוָּ֖אר סֶֽלָה׃פ נָקַ֤בְתָּ בְמַטָּיו֙ רֹ֣אשׁ פְּרָזוֹ יִסְעֲר֖וּ לַהֲפִיצֵ֑נִי עֲלִ֣יצֻתָ֔ם כְּמוֹ־ לֶאֱכֹ֥ל עָנִ֖י בַּמִּסְתָּֽר׃

passages.text: You trampled the sea with Your horses, churning the great waters.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful.
God moves with strength.
God leads His horses across the sea.
God tramples the sea with His horses.
God stirs up the great waters.
The waters churn under God’s power.
passages.original: דָּרַ֥כְתָּ בַיָּ֖ם סוּסֶ֑יךָ חֹ֖מֶר מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: I heard and trembled within; my lips quivered at the sound. Decay entered my bones; I trembled where I stood. Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress to come upon the people who invade us.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Habakkuk speaks these words.
Habakkuk hears a message from God.
He feels fear deep inside.
His lips begin to quiver when he hears the sound.
He feels weakness enter his bones.
He trembles where he stands.
Habakkuk knows trouble will come.
He must wait quietly for the day of distress.
This day will come upon the people who attack and invade them.
passages.original: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי׀ וַתִּרְגַּ֣ז בִּטְנִ֗י לְקוֹל֙ צָלֲל֣וּ שְׂפָתַ֔י יָב֥וֹא רָקָ֛ב בַּעֲצָמַ֖י וְתַחְתַּ֣י אֶרְגָּ֑ז אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנ֙וּחַ֙ לְי֣וֹם צָרָ֔ה לַעֲל֖וֹת לְעַ֥ם יְגוּדֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls, yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
passages.sermon:
The prophet Habakkuk speaks during a time of trouble.
He describes a situation of complete loss.
The fig tree does not bud.
There is no fruit on the vines.
The olive crop fails.
The fields produce no food.
The sheep are gone from the fold.
There are no cattle in the stalls.
Habakkuk still chooses to rejoice.
He exults in the LORD.
He rejoices in the God who saves him.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ תְאֵנָ֣ה לֹֽא־ תִפְרָ֗ח וְאֵ֤ין יְבוּל֙ בַּגְּפָנִ֔ים כִּחֵשׁ֙ מַעֲשֵׂה־ זַ֔יִת וּשְׁדֵמ֖וֹת לֹא־ עָ֣שָׂה אֹ֑כֶל גָּזַ֤ר מִמִּכְלָה֙ צֹ֔אן וְאֵ֥ין בָּקָ֖ר בָּרְפָתִֽים׃ וַאֲנִ֖י בַּיהוָ֣ה אֶעְל֑וֹזָה אָגִ֖ילָה בֵּאלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃

passages.text: GOD the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer; He makes me walk upon the heights! For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.
passages.sermon:
The LORD God is my strength.
He gives me power.
He makes my feet swift like a deer.
He helps me walk on high places.
This is for the choirmaster.
Play it with stringed instruments.
passages.original: יְהוִ֤הּ אֲדֹנָי֙ חֵילִ֔י וַיָּ֤שֶׂם רַגְלַי֙ כָּֽאַיָּל֔וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַדְרִכֵ֑נִי לַמְנַצֵּ֖חַ בִּנְגִינוֹתָֽי׃
